Container.Name: media-agent
Container.Overview: Docker-first completed-media import and linking tool for Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby libraries. Scans completed downloads, matches TMDB metadata, plans dry-run imports, and links files only when explicitly enabled.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: plex jellyfin emby tmdb hardlink media library nas
Container.Author: Team-Cyan

Config.Name: Appdata Root
Config.Description: Single mounted root containing runtime/config, runtime/local, runtime/.media-agent, and runtime/state.

Config.Name: Downloads Root
Config.Description: Completed-download source root visible to media-agent. Use rw for hardlinks; dry-run scans do not mutate source files.

Config.Name: Media Root
Config.Description: Target media-library root where movie, TV, and anime folders are linked.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: Primary entry mode for the container.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path to the runtime config file inside the mounted root.

Config.Name: State Dir
Config.Description: Writable SQLite state and JSONL audit directory.

Config.Name: Execute
Config.Description: Keep false for dry-run scheduler mode. Set true only after reviewing import plans.

Config.Name: Heartbeat File
Config.Description: Heartbeat file used by Docker health checks and runtime visibility.

Config.Name: Max Staleness Minutes
Config.Description: Healthcheck staleness threshold for the scheduler heartbeat.

Config.Name: Startup Status Log
Config.Description: Print a redacted runtime-status JSON line on container startup so Docker logs show version, config path, heartbeat path, and mounted state visibility.

Config.Name: Enable Web UI
Config.Description: Start the operational Web UI next to the scheduler so DockerMan's WebUI button can open it.

Config.Name: Web UI Host
Config.Description: Bind address for the in-container Web UI server. Keep 0.0.0.0 for Docker bridge publishing.

Config.Name: Web UI Internal Port
Config.Description: Internal Web UI port inside the container. Keep this aligned with the container side of the port mapping.

Config.Name: WebUI Host Port
Config.Description: Host port for DockerMan's WebUI button. Change only the host side if 8775 is already in use.
